name: Decanter Images
author: winesoft

sections.description:
Decanter Images converts JPEG and PNG images to WebP and AVIF when they are uploaded. Conversion runs on your own server using GD or Imagick; no external service is used.

Images are served with a <picture> element so each browser gets AVIF, WebP, or the original, in that order of preference.

  • Choose which source formats to convert (JPEG, PNG).
  • Set WebP and AVIF quality separately.
  • Keep or remove the original files (originals are kept by default).
  • A converted file larger than its original is discarded.
  • An admin notice is shown when the server cannot create WebP or AVIF.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the decanter-images folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Adjust the options on the plugin’s settings page.
sections.faq:
Are existing images converted?

No. Only images uploaded after activation are converted.
